description: Indiana EAP helps eligible households with heating and electricity costs. Local service providers process applications for IHCDA.
introduction: Indiana EAP helps eligible households with heating and electricity costs. Local service providers process applications for IHCDA.

sections.who: IHCDA uses household-size income limits based on 60% of state median income and reviews the most recent three months of income. Households whose utilities are included in rent may also qualify.
sections.get: EAP provides an annual energy benefit, generally paid to the supplier. It does not cover every energy bill. Explain any disconnection or depleted fuel supply promptly.
sections.docs:
• Income evidence.
  • Current utility statements.
  • A lease or tenant verification statement when utilities are included in rent.
  • Additional records requested for your circumstances.
sections.apply:
1. Find your provider

    Use IHCDA’s county lookup.

  2. Apply for the current season

    The 2026–2027 window runs October 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027. Apply online through LITT, or arrange mail or in-person intake with your provider.

  3. Save your login details

    LITT replaces EAPConnect. Retain its login number, code and submission confirmation.
sections.after: Continue making payments while the request is reviewed. For a shutoff, contact both the utility and provider. Follow the written appeal instructions if denied.
sections.sources: Reviewed October 1, 2026 using IHCDA EAP instructions and current season. The administering provider determines eligibility and availability.
